trigger_text: proposed_start_date is within 12 months after restoration_completion_date
reason: PMC reinstatement remains within its one-year defect-liability period.
source: PMC Guidelines for Trenching Activity in Pune City, Road Department, Part A Conditions 10–13

trigger_text: CC/mastic road OR active defect-liability period
reason: PMC requires prior Road Chief Engineer approval for unavoidable excavation in the relevant protected cases.
source: PMC Guidelines for Trenching Activity in Pune City, Part B Condition 49

trigger_text: routine excavation proposed from 30 April through 30 September
reason: Routine trench excavation is restricted during the PMC monsoon period except emergency cases.
source: PMC Guidelines for Trenching Activity in Pune City, Road Department

reason: PMC provides an emergency pathway with rapid repair/removal requirements.
source: PMC Guidelines for Trenching Activity in Pune City, Part E — Fault Reinstatement

trigger_text: fault repair during restricted period without appropriate sanction
reason: Emergency excavation footprint is controlled during the restricted season unless appropriate sanction applies.
source: PMC Guidelines for Trenching Activity in Pune City, Part E — Fault Reinstatement

reason: Long trenches should be staged so the next section is not opened before the preceding section is cleared/reinstated.
source: PMC Guidelines for Trenching Activity in Pune City, permit conditions / Annexure 15

trigger_text: planned utility trenching is absent from annual coordinated programme
reason: PMC's process is designed to synchronize utility programmes before execution.
source: PMC Guidelines for Trenching Activity in Pune City, Part B Condition 1

trigger_text: same proponent excavated same location within previous 6 months OR plans another opening within 6 months
reason: XPMS treats these as repeated-opening scenarios.
source: Hong Kong Highways Department — XPMS Guideline for Infrequent Excavation Permit Applicants

trigger_text: other proponent excavated same location within previous 3 months OR plans work within 3 months
reason: XPMS identifies closely spaced openings by different proponents as repeated opening.
source: Hong Kong Highways Department — XPMS Guideline for Infrequent Excavation Permit Applicants

trigger_text: different proponents have spatially conflicting works within 3–6 months
reason: Common-trench/date coordination can prevent repeated openings.

trigger_text: compatible OFC/power/gas or similar works are planned on the same urban road area
reason: MoHUA recommends coordinated laying to avoid duplication of digging/laying.
source: MoHUA Advisory on coordinated laying of OFC/power/gas pipelines, 30 May 2017

trigger_text: protected arterial/newly reconstructed road within configured protection period
reason: Configured city policy protects strategic arterial road investment from repeated cutting.
source: CorridorIQ PS — configurable Pune demo policy

trigger_text: recently restored stretch within configured restoration window
reason: Creates an explicit city-planning protection check before re-cutting recently restored pavement.
source: CorridorIQ PS — configurable Pune demo policy

trigger_text: affected segment intersects configured critical-facility context AND coordination opportunity exists
reason: Hospital, school, transit and other critical functions influence which coordination strategy is preferable.

trigger_text: 2+ permits overlap spatially on same corridor segment and execution windows overlap or fall within configured coordination window
reason: The Corridor Case changes the decision unit from individual projects to the shared road corridor.

trigger_text: spatially overlapping permits proposed for joint execution
reason: Spatial and temporal overlap does not prove that utilities can safely share a trench.
